items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Your grandmother was Jefferson, Rose Jefferson. And so, Uncle Hendry anyway, was that New Iberia too? [INTERVIEWEE] I think it was Jefferson, Theresa Jefferson.

ctx.x: I can't remember his mother's name though. Maria Theresa was her first name.
Theresa Johnson. Theresa or something, I thought it was Theresa. Yeah.
But what her name was before Jefferson I guess.
